title: BerryAntiCheat
description: A modern anti-cheat for Paper 1.21+, featuring GeyserMC & Floodgate support, combat, movement, inventory and bot checks with separate Bedrock configuration.
body:
# BerryAntiCheat

## Modern AntiCheat for Paper, GeyserMC & Floodgate

BerryAntiCheat is a lightweight yet powerful anti-cheat solution designed for modern Minecraft servers.

Built specifically for **Paper 1.21+**, BerryAntiCheat focuses on providing reliable cheat detection while maintaining compatibility with **GeyserMC** and **Floodgate**. Unlike many anti-cheat plugins, Bedrock players are not simply ignored and can be configured separately from Java players.

Whether you run a Survival, SMP, CityBuild, Lifesteal or Network server, BerryAntiCheat provides a clean and highly configurable solution to protect your players.

---

# Features

## Combat Checks

✔ Reach

✔ KillAura

✔ AutoClicker

✔ Anti-Knockback

## Movement Checks

✔ Speed

✔ Fly

✔ Timer

✔ NoFall

✔ ElytraFly

✔ Jesus (Water Walk)

## Block Checks

✔ FastBreak

✔ FastPlace

✔ Scaffold

## Inventory Checks

✔ InventoryMove

✔ FastConsume

✔ ChestStealer

## Protection Checks

✔ AntiBot

✔ Violation System

✔ Automatic Punishments

✔ Staff Alerts

✔ Per-Check Configuration

✔ Per-Check Bypass Permissions

---

# Bedrock Support

BerryAntiCheat was designed with cross-platform servers in mind.

Features include:

✔ Floodgate detection

✔ Bedrock-specific thresholds

✔ Bedrock-only or Java-only checks

✔ Adjustable Bedrock leniency

✔ Reduced false positives

✔ Optional Bedrock check exclusions

---

# Commands

/berryac status

Displays plugin information.

/berryac reload

Reloads the configuration.

/berryac alerts

Toggle anti-cheat alerts.

/berryac vl <player>

View a player's violation level.

/berryac reset <player>

Reset a player's violations.

---

# Permissions

berryac.use

berryac.admin

berryac.alerts

berryac.bypass

berryac.bypass.<check>

Examples:

berryac.bypass.speed

berryac.bypass.fly

berryac.bypass.reach

berryac.bypass.autoclicker

berryac.bypass.scaffold

---

# Supported Software

✔ Paper 1.21.x

✔ Purpur 1.21.x

✔ Pufferfish 1.21.x

✔ Java 21+

---

# Recommended Setup

Paper 1.21.x

Floodgate

GeyserMC

Java 21

---

# Why BerryAntiCheat?

Many anti-cheat plugins either lack proper Bedrock support or generate excessive false positives when used alongside GeyserMC.

BerryAntiCheat was built specifically to address this issue by providing configurable detection systems for both Java and Bedrock players while maintaining server performance.

The goal is simple:

Detect common cheats.

Reduce false positives.

Support cross-play servers.

Remain lightweight.
